# discord_role (List Resource)

Lists the roles of a server, except `@everyone` (`discord_role_everyone`) and roles managed by an integration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
list "discord_role" "all" {
  provider         = discord
  include_resource = true

  config {
    server_id = var.server_id
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild) to list roles of.
